title: Initiative timebox & escalation matrix for SLO-driven reliability campaigns
creator: Noah Chen
description: Summary: Define and pilot a standardized timeboxing cadence and multi-layered escalation matrix for reliability initiatives driven by SLI targets and error-budget consumption. The goal is to reduce ambiguity across teams when an SLO breach is imminent or occurring, ensure consistent decisioning about mitigation vs. feature throttling, and shorten mean time to remediation for production-facing regressions.

Scope: This ticket covers the product-management playbook (decision checkpoints, timeboxes, ownership handoffs), a cross-team escalation matrix (who owns what at which error budget burn thresholds), and a lightweight dashboard integration showing real-time state (OK / Warning / Escalation) for each initiative. Implementation will include a template for initiative docs, an example timeline applied to two active reliability initiatives, and a runbook for on-call and PM responsibilities during each escalation phase.
Out of scope: Automated rollback tooling, infra-level throttles, or changes to SLI definitions themselves. Those are separate engineering tickets and policy discussions linked in dependencies.

Rationale: We have inconsistent reactions to SLI degradations across product areas; some teams over-rotate and block launches, others let burn continue until customer impact. A clear, timeboxed playbook aligned to error-budget tranches will reduce coordination friction and provide predictable product cadence while protecting customer experience.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A published playbook (Confluence) describing three escalation tranches tied to quantitative error-budget thresholds and concrete PM/Eng/Oncall actions for each tranche.
A2: A one-page initiative template that includes SLI target, measurement window, owner, rollback criteria, and a 14-day timebox example populated for two active initiatives.
A3: Dashboard widget prototype in the Console that surfaces initiative state (OK / Warning / Escalation) and shows error-budget burn rate over the past 24h and 7d.
A4: Stakeholder review completed with Engineering Reliability lead, two product-area PMs, Design for communication templates, and Legal verifying no customer-facing commitments are implied.
A5: Pilot run executed on Initiative-Alpha and Initiative-Bravo with documented outcomes and a short retrospective (lessons learned + next actions).
A6: Hand-off checklist and ownership manifest stored in the initiative doc for on-call vs. PM responsibilities during escalations.
